COV.note: OneFPL: Awoniyi and Simms compete at striker.

CRY.note: OneFPL: back three, Mitchell as wing-back.

EVE.note: OneFPL: Pickford fit, Ndiaye key, Garner's fitness open.

FUL.note: OneFPL: Garcia leads the striker race.

HUL.note: OneFPL: Tzolakis in the goalkeeping race; Hughes out.

IPS.note: OneFPL: Scherpen; Diop and Greaves at centre-back.
